summary: Comprehensive testing of new features for Auto Transport Brokerage CRM iteration 8. All 9 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend tests verified all new features: auto-calc pricing, USA route map, transport facts, zip codes, and approve-all-prices flow.

backend: GET /api/leads/pricing/{id} - Returns pricing for all 3 types (standard, expedited, enclosed) with distance
POST /api/leads/{id}/approve - Saves all 3 pricing types and converts lead to quote
POST /api/leads/{id}/approve - Returns 400 for already quoted lead
PUT /api/orders/{id} - Saves pricing fields and zip codes
Distance calculation - LA to Houston returns ~1400-1800 miles
frontend: Lead detail: Pricing section shows all 3 shipping types (Standard, Expedited, Enclosed)
Lead detail: Auto-calculated total = deposit + carrier + mileage when fields change
Lead detail: Estimated distance displayed (1,782 miles for LA to Houston)
Lead detail: Mileage cost calculated per shipping type ($0.75/mi, $0.95/mi, $1/mi)
Lead detail: Recalculate button present and functional
Lead detail: Approve All Prices button present with correct message
Lead detail: Approve All Prices converts lead to quote and redirects
Lead detail: USA route map renders with all US states
Lead detail: Route line (animated dashed) between pickup (blue) and delivery (green) markers
Lead detail: Map legend shows pickup and delivery locations
Lead detail: Route Intelligence section with city facts (LA traffic, Houston Katy Freeway)
Lead detail: State facts grid with Weather, Transport, Roads for CA and TX
Lead detail: Zip code fields present for pickup and delivery
Quote detail: All 3 pricing cards editable (Standard, Expedited, Enclosed)
Quote detail: Zip code fields present
Order detail: All 3 pricing cards editable
Order detail: Dispatch & Carrier section with status, carrier info, driver info
Order detail: Pickup & Delivery dates editable

critical_code_review_comments: PricingEditor component correctly implements auto-calc: total = deposit + carrier + (distance * rate)
USARouteMap uses SVG with state coordinates and animated route line between pickup/delivery
TransportFacts provides comprehensive state and city facts about weather, transport, and roads
LeadApproveInput model correctly accepts all 3 pricing types and estimated_distance
Backend correctly saves pricing_standard, pricing_expedited, pricing_enclosed on approve/update
seed_data_creation: Created test lead BR039832 (Test Approve Flow Customer, LA to Houston) for approve flow testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: New features fully tested and working: 1) Auto-calc pricing (total = deposit + carrier + mileage), 2) USA route map with animated line between states, 3) Transport facts (city and state facts about weather, roads, transport), 4) Zip code fields in pickup/delivery, 5) All 3 shipping types editable in leads/quotes/orders, 6) Approve All Prices converts lead to quote with all pricing saved. Backend endpoints: GET /api/leads/pricing/{id}, POST /api/leads/{id}/approve, PUT /api/quotes/{id}, PUT /api/orders/{id}.
